goal: Add Omada 6.3 AP-group and Wi-Fi network management to the Omada WLAN Manager Electron app, groundwork first.

phases.title: Renderer/main bug fixes
phases.summary: Fixes the confirm-modal leak, navigation checks, URL crash, disconnect IPC and load-failure state.

phases.title: API client robustness
phases.summary: Merges cookies, adds HTTP status, timeout and size limits, re-login on session expiry and logout.

phases.title: Config and credential security
phases.summary: Encrypts the stored password, keeps it out of the renderer and writes config atomically.

phases.title: Renderer, IPC and certificate hardening
phases.summary: Builds DOM safely, sandboxes the preload, checks IPC senders and tightens the CSP.

phases.title: Packaging and platform
phases.summary: Adds the Windows icon, trims packaged files and scopes macOS title-bar styling.

phases.title: UX improvements
phases.summary: Replaces alerts with toasts, adds refresh and spinners, keyboard navigation and accessible modals.

phases.title: Connection flow and multi-site
phases.summary: Lets the user pick a site on multi-site controllers and serializes connection attempts.

phases.title: Renderer modularization with esbuild
phases.summary: Bundles the renderer with esbuild, splits it into modules and reuses the shared types.

phases.title: Test harness
phases.summary: Adds npm test with fixture-based unit tests and a committed Playwright GUI smoke against a stubbed main.

phases.title: Electron upgrade
phases.summary: Upgrades Electron 28 to 44, electron-builder to 26 and TypeScript to 7, with build, tests and smoke green.

phases.title: URL-scoped credentials and certificate pinning
phases.summary: Clears credentials and the pin when the controller URL changes, and pins its certificate on first use before any login.

phases.title: Omada 6.3 correctness
phases.summary: Detects the controller version and group model, lists empty AP groups from setting/wlans and switches AP/WLAN group wording.

phases.title: New app shell and Access points view
phases.summary: Adds a sidebar shell and an Access points view with multi-select and bulk moves.

phases.title: Read-only AP groups and Wi-Fi networks views
phases.summary: Adds read-only AP group and Wi-Fi network views with cross-navigation and responsive layout.

phases.title: Open API credentials and client
phases.summary: Adds optional Open API credentials, an Open API client, a controller session and capability detection.

phases.title: AP group management
phases.summary: Lets the user create, rename and delete empty AP groups and move APs into them.

phases.title: Wi-Fi network read model
phases.summary: Reads Wi-Fi networks through the Open API with secrets stripped.

phases.title: Wi-Fi network editing
phases.summary: Edits Open and WPA-Personal Wi-Fi networks with read-merge-write and password change.

phases.title: Broadcast-on binding editor
phases.summary: Edits which AP groups broadcast each Wi-Fi network, with capacity checks.

phases.title: Integration, hardening and docs
phases.summary: Integrates the features, hardens edge cases and writes the live-test checklist.
